requirement_vague: Verify article creation generates slug correctly from title and article can be retrieved by slug
requirement_precise: Create a user (username: 'author1', email: 'author1@test.com', password: 'pass123') and authenticate. Create an article with title 'My Test Article', description 'Test description', body 'Article body content', tagList ['testing', 'nestjs']. Verify response status is 201. Verify the returned article has 'title' equal to 'My Test Article', 'description' equal to 'Test description', 'tagList' containing 'testing' and 'nestjs', and 'slug' starting with 'my-test-article-' (lowercase with hyphen suffix). Extract the slug. Retrieve the article via GET /api/articles/{slug}. Verify status 200 and the returned article title is 'My Test Article'.

implementation.reasoning: The code generates the article slug from the lowercased title with non-alphanumeric characters converted to hyphens and appends a random hex suffix, which satisfies the required 'my-test-article-' prefix behavior. The created article response includes the article fields via article_dict, and the GET /api/articles/{slug} endpoint retrieves the article by that slug and returns it with the original title.
